array.name: gps_tips_descriptions
array.item: Open Settings → Location → Mode and choose High accuracy.
Turn GPS off, then on again to refresh the satellite lock.
Stand in an open space; avoid tall buildings, tunnels, or underground parking.
Leave Wi‑Fi and Bluetooth scanning enabled for faster A‑GPS, even when not connected.
Keep the phone still for about 10 seconds to let the GPS chip stabilise.
Turn Battery Saver off; it can throttle GPS accuracy.
Wave the phone in a figure‑8 motion to recalibrate the compass.
Remove metal cases or magnetic mounts that can block the GPS antenna.
